purpose: Sanitized fresh-precondition evidence schema for RA Pro billing-company cutover. Exact retained file bytes are SHA-pinned by tip authorization before production dry-run may prompt or connect.

authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_precondition_evidence_sha256: 64-hex lowercase SHA-256 of retained evidence file bytes (null while UNPUBLISHED)
authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_precondition_freeze: 40-hex executable freeze that sealed the intake tooling (null while UNPUBLISHED)
authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_precondition_evidence_tip: 40-hex tip that published the pin (null while UNPUBLISHED)
authority_pins_in_tooling_authorization.required_precondition_bundle_source: 40-hex bundle-source companion identity when published (null while UNPUBLISHED)

field_types.source_channel_classification: string (sanitized channel label only; no secrets)
field_types.valid_until_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp string (must be strictly after UtcNow at gate time)

gate_aware_production_deployment.deployment_id_or_url_identity: opaque non-secret string identity (never a live credentialed URL)

optional_agreement_fields.wrapper: optional object; when present, overlapping sanitized fields must agree with applicator
optional_agreement_fields.applicator: optional object; when present, overlapping sanitized fields must agree with wrapper

forbidden_content: Customer, firm, user, or tenant identifiers (including UUID/GUID shapes)
Stripe object ids (cus_*, sub_*, evt_*, in_*, pi_*, price_*, prod_*)
Credentialed database URLs (postgres:// or postgresql:// with user:password@)
Session secrets, API keys, tokens, PEM material, or connection strings
Raw SQL, request/response payloads, or unsanitized log excerpts
Live production deployment URLs used as authority beyond opaque deployment_id_or_url_identity
Any open commerce-gate observation (observed must never be open)
fail_closed_conditions: PRECONDITION_PINS_UNPUBLISHED: required_precondition_evidence_sha256 / freeze / tip / bundle_source are null OR published_precondition_evidence.status is UNPUBLISHED/missing
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_SHA_MISMATCH: SHA-256 of retained evidence bytes does not match required_precondition_evidence_sha256
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_INVALID: malformed JSON, missing required fields, or wrong types
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_EXPIRED: valid_until_utc is not strictly after UtcNow
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_COLLECTION_WINDOW: collected_at_utc is after valid_until_utc or before valid_from_utc
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_COMMERCE_GATE: commerce_gate.observed not absent|closed OR never_open is not true
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_INVENTORY: ceremony_inventory is not total=4 / company_owned=3 / firm_owned=1 / classification=active_and_complimentary
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION: history_count_expected!=187 OR target_version_absent!=20260915004500 OR objects_absent!=true
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_FORBIDDEN_CONTENT: retained JSON contains UUID / Stripe id / credentialed postgres URL / secret-like material
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_WRAPPER_APPLICATOR: wrapper/applicator present and disagree on overlapping sanitized fields
PRECONDITION_EVIDENCE_CONTRADICTION: contradictory counts or mutually exclusive boolean observations
notes: This file is a contract/schema document only. Do not treat example_shape nulls as production evidence.
No fresh production precondition collection is authorized under unpublished pins; ceremonies must fail closed with PRECONDITION_PINS_UNPUBLISHED before SecureString prompt, Node, or DB.
Fresh cutover-precondition evidence is distinct from prior production dry-run evidence (required_prior_dry_run_*).
